videos.title: The Big Match Revisited
videos.description: With the first division title going down to the wire, Bobby Robson's Ipswich Town needed a win against Middlesbrough to maintain their challenge or else Aston Villa would be crowned champions. Also includes action from relegation candidates Nor-wich City and Leicester City and West Bromwich Albion against Tottenham Hotspur. Presented by Brian Moore and Jim Rosenthal.

videos.title: The Big Match Revisited
videos.description: Brian Moore introduces highlights from August 1977. We travel up and down the country as Millwall take on South London rivals Crystal Palace, Leeds head to the North East to face Newcastle and Birmingham City host Manchester United.

videos.title: The Memoirs of Sherlock Holmes
videos.description: In Watson's absence, Holmes is joined by his brother Mycroft in an investigation into the murder of a secretary to an invalid professor. The only clues they have are the young man's dying words and a pair of pince-nez found clutched in his hand.

videos.title: Live: ITV Racing
videos.description: Oli Bell and the team are at Newbury ahead of another brilliant day of racing.

videos.title: The Big Match Revisited
videos.description: Brian Moore introduces highlights from October 1972 as title contenders Arsenal entertained Manchester City at Highbury in a match which saw City denied by a very controversial decision from the referee.

videos.title: Monster Carp
videos.description: The intrepid trio continue their mission to track down the largest carp in the world, and find themselves in Slovenia, a country in which none of them have ever wet a line previously.

videos.title: Fishing Allstars
videos.description: Dean Macey and match ace Adam Rooney go fishing for barbel and chub on the River Wye, one of the most beautiful rivers in the UK.

videos.title: Live: ITV Racing Live
videos.description: Ed Chamberlin presents live racing from Newbury and Newcastle. The Coral Gold Cup is the feature race at Newbury, whilst at Newcastle the Grade One Fighting Fifth Hurdle takes centre stage. Analysis from Sir AP McCoy, Ruby Walsh and Mick FitzGerald, reporting from Oli Bell and Alice Plunkett and commentary from Richard Hoiles.

videos.title: The Best of the 70s
videos.description: A look back at a selection of the wide variety of sports covered by ITV during the 1970s - from horse racing to table football, Formula 1 to darts - and including many iconic and memorable moments.

videos.title: The Protectors
videos.description: A beautiful blonde who has run away from home earns her money by passing on mysterious messages full of seemingly random numbers.

videos.title: The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
videos.description: The vicar of Amberley village asks Holmes to look into several deaths that have taken place since the arrival of a man said to be descended from vampires. Though the village is gripped by fear, Holmes is convinced there is a rational explanation.

videos.title: Live: Players Championship Finals
videos.description: Just 16 players remain at the PDC Players Championship Finals, and the stakes are rising. It's time for the third round, with matches now extended to the first to 10 legs as the players fight for a place in the quarter-finals. With two boards delivering the action, who will hold their nerve and take another step towards the 130,000-pound top prize?

videos.title: 6 Bullets
videos.description: A mercenary who specialises in finding missing children is hired to rescue the kidnapped daughter of a champion in mixed martial arts.

videos.title: Minder
videos.description: Arthur discovers that he may be next in line to inherit a fortune, but can he trace back the Daley ancestry?

videos.title: Two and a Half Men
videos.description: When their mother looks to be spending her birthday alone, Jake tricks Alan and Charlie into the unthinkable.

videos.title: Two and a Half Men
videos.description: Charlie falls for the woman who replaces Berta on her days off; Alan thinks Lyndsey's ex-husband is stalking him.

videos.title: Teleshopping
videos.description: Presenting the latest products live on television that can be ordered directly. The product range extends from vacuum cleaners and bath towels to sports equipment.

videos.title: Motorsport Mundial
videos.description: The latest motorsport news and action from around the globe. From Superbikes to Formula One, Motorsport Mundial has the latest action and talking points from the motorsport world.

videos.title: Auto Mundial
videos.description: The narrator provides insight into the world of the automobile industry while highlighting the latest car models that are released in the international market.

videos.title: Minder on the Orient Express
videos.description: When a gangster passes away, he leaves his daughter with clues to the location of his ill-gotten gains. She offers Terry tickets to the Orient Express, and Terry and Arthur spot underworld business on the luxury train to Venice.

videos.description: Action from across the Football League, including Lincoln v Wolves, Birmingham v Bolton, QPR v Sheffield United and West Ham v Stoke in the Championship.

videos.title: The Big Match Revisited
videos.description: Brian Moore introduces highlights from October 1972 as title contenders Arsenal entertained Manchester City at Highbury in a match which saw City denied by a very controversial decision from the referee.

videos.title: The Motorbike Show
videos.description: Motorcycle guru Henry Cole is in the Yorkshire Dales taking in the delights of some of the UK's best motorcycling roads. He also tells the story of Indian - one of America's most venerable motorbike brands, and begins the rebuild of his BSA Goldstar.

videos.title: Nijinsky's Triple Crown
videos.description: Short sports film about the legendary race horse.

videos.title: Live: Players Championship Finals
videos.description: It's Finals Day at the PDC Players Championship Finals, live from Butlin's Minehead. Eight players remain, but only four can progress to the semi-finals. With the trophy and 130,000-pound winner's cheque getting ever closer, the pressure is on as the quarter-finals take centre stage. Join Pete Graves, Chris Mason, Mark Webster and Glen Durrant for a huge afternoon of darts.

videos.title: Junk and Disorderly
videos.description: From museum rummaging to auction deals, Henry and Skid load up on fresh finds and head to Newark Autojumble to keep the momentum going.

videos.title: American Pickers
videos.description: The guys decide to gamble big money on a huge stuffed elephant head and Danielle meets a rock'n'roll legend.

videos.title: Live: Players Championship Finals
videos.description: After three days of incredible darts, it's time to crown the PDC Players Championship Finals champion. Four players remain, with two blockbuster semi-finals and the World Youth Championship final, followed by the showpiece final, where 130,000 pounds and one of the sport's biggest titles await the winner.

videos.title: English Football League Highlights
videos.description: Action from across the Football League, including Lincoln v Wolves, Birmingham v Bolton, QPR v Sheffield United and West Ham v Stoke in the Championship.

videos.title: The Protectors
videos.description: When the troubleshooters go after smugglers in Malta, they have no idea what exactly is being smuggled, but a clue does turn up in the form of a dead hippie.

videos.title: Snatch
videos.description: Vic embarks on a rogue mission while Lily finds some independence with an American expat; while pulling off a job for Mayor Ortega, Albert learns some intel that might break the mayor's grip on the gang; an Interpol agent comes to town on a mission.

videos.title: Two and a Half Men
videos.description: Charlie raves about his new conquest Michelle. But his initial enthusiasm disappears when he learns that she is four years older than him. Then he meets her 20-year-old daughter Shauna, who is more his type.

videos.title: Two and a Half Men
videos.description: Michelle is surprisingly understanding about Charlie's chequered past and dysfunctional family, but then Rose turns up.

videos.title: The Professionals
videos.description: Take a dangerous drug, add a killing or three, an addict, and a crazy man. Stir well, and you have big, big trouble for Cowley and Co.

videos.title: The Professionals
videos.description: The Prime Minister's private telephone number appears on a pad in a slain prostitute's flat.

videos.title: Minder
videos.description: One of Arthur's money-making schemes goes wrong and The Winchester Club is faced with closure.

videos.title: Sapphire and Steel
videos.description: Lead helps Sapphire and Steel in their fight to overcome the forces of evil in the house as the time break strengthens after a nursery rhyme hidden in a book becomes stuck in Helen's head.

videos.title: Sapphire and Steel
videos.description: Rob is trapped in the cellar after being lured by a figure he takes to be his father, while Sapphire and Steel fear the worst when they discover that all three pools of light are there with him.

videos.description: The hotels of Europe are Watson's hunting ground when Holmes sends him out alone to search for a missing Englishwoman. But they soon discover the trail is hotter in London.

videos.title: The Professionals
videos.description: Innocent people are in jeopardy and there is a protection job for Bodie and Doyle.

videos.title: Sapphire and Steel
videos.description: Sapphire and Steel investigate events at a disused railway station, where the Darkness is feeding on the resentment of those who died prematurely, including a soldier killed during the First World War.

videos.title: Sapphire and Steel
videos.description: Sapphire and Steel encounter a bitter soldier who was killed during the First World War, but Time is playing mysterious tricks, and the duo also find themselves up against sailors and airmen from the Second World War.

videos.title: The Casebook of Sherlock Holmes
videos.description: When a beautiful young governess is accused of murder, her employer calls upon the services of Sherlock Holmes, and it is up to him to prove her innocence before it is too late.

videos.title: The Debrief with Dan and Rog
videos.description: Claire Thomas is joined by Dan Biggar and Ronan O'Gara to review the Rugby Nations Championship Finals weekend, as the competition draws to a close with all six matches played at the Allianz Stadium in Twickenham.

videos.title: Live: NHL Hockey
videos.description: Live coverage of the National Hockey League as the Ottawa Senators clash with the Nashville Predators at the Bridgestone Arena. It was a tight contest in the teams' previous meeting in October, with Shane Pinto scoring a shootout winner to seal a 3-2 victory for the Senators.

videos.title: Goals of the 90s
videos.description: A look at some of the greatest goals from the 1990s, including memorable World Cup strikes by Platt, Maradona and Owen, and Euros classics from Gascoigne, Suker and Poborsky.

videos.title: The Whole Nine Yards
videos.description: The wife of a dentist convinces him to betray their new neighbour - a hit man turned informant - to the Chicago gangsters who want him dead. In need of money in order to hurry through a divorce, the young man arranges a meeting with the Mob in which he will exchange information for cash, but when his scheming wife tells the hit man what he is up to, it is the dentist's life that is placed in grave danger.

videos.title: Hanover Street
videos.description: David Halloran, a US pilot, finds himself in the arms of nurse Margaret Sellinger. Although she's married, the pair start an affair. Then, Halloran is given a mission - to fly secret agent Paul Sellinger, Margaret's husband, on a mission into the heart of Occupied France. Neither knows of the other's love for Margaret until, downed and on the run, Paul learns of the affair and must choose between his wife and his mission.
